summary: [Typeform] webhooks: PUT /forms/{form_id}/webhooks/{tag} with {url, enabled, secret, verify_ssl}. Operator-chosen tag; multiple tags per form (fan-out). Sign: Typeform-Signature = "sha256=<base64>" keyed by per-webhook secret; verify before processing. 2xx within 30s; auto-disabled after sustained failures; retried on 5xx ~24h. Replay-safe dedupe by response_id.
